copilot_instructions.title: DroidNet
authorities: Follow root AGENTS.md and applicable module instructions. For Oxygen work, read design/oxygen/RULES.md; engine workflows are in projects/Oxygen.Engine/AGENTS.md.
Trust manifests, scripts and evaluated configuration over stale README commands. Managed build/test commands are documented in tooling/doc/build.md.
boundaries: Managed/WinUI libraries and editor modules live under projects/. Oxygen.Engine is a separate Conan/CMake/C++ project, excluded from managed solution generation.
The editor's startup, DI and routing wiring is in projects/Oxygen.Editor/src/Program.cs. It uses Bootstrap, Hosting, DryIoc and the MVVM generators.
Editor/interop builds consume projects/Oxygen.Engine/out/install/<Configuration>; editor-only work does not authorize an engine build.
workflow: In PowerShell, run ./init.ps1 -NoRestore to provision and activate shared Python tooling, restore pinned .NET tools and install hooks; -DotNetInstall is opt-in.

On Windows, only 64-bit build hosts and x64-hosted MSVC compilers/linkers are permitted. Use MSBuild\Current\Bin\amd64\MSBuild.exe and vcvars64.bat (or -arch=x64 -host_arch=x64), with /p:PreferredToolArchitecture=x64. Never use 32-bit MSBuild or Hostx86 tools. Verify resolved tool paths and keep the same Visual Studio installation across builders; target x64 alone is insufficient. SDK-internal utilities are not build-host selection.
Use scoped 64-bit Visual Studio MSBuild /restore /m builds. Generate solutions with tooling/GenerateSolution.ps1 or a project's open.cmd -NoLaunch, not dotnet slngen.
Build tests before traverse Invoke-Tests --start projects/<module>/tests --configuration Debug. Forward single-test selection after --: --filter FullyQualifiedName~MyTest.

Managed tests use MSTest.Sdk/Microsoft.Testing.Platform; native interop tests use VSTest; engine tests use GoogleTest/CTest. Use the shared unpackaged WinUI test host unless package identity is required.
Diagnostic analyzers are opt-in during builds: /p:RunAnalyzersDuringBuild=true. Source generators still run; do not disable them or suppress warnings to bypass validation.

Query managed/interop outputs with get-artifacts; they live under root artifacts/. NuGet versions belong in Directory.packages.props; SDK/tool selections belong in global.json and .config/dotnet-tools.json.
All Python tooling uses the root uv.lock and .venv. Run uv sync --locked; change the owning manifest and root lock together when updating dependencies.
Run pre-commit only on changed files. Follow the root AGENTS.md line-ending and fixture-preservation rules.

rules: Read .editorconfig and Common.props; do not hardcode a C# version or copy MSBuild settings into project files.
Write compliant code from the first edit, including member order. Avoid trial-and-error analyzer cycles and broad reordering sweeps; this is not permission to ignore or suppress diagnostics.
Use explicit access modifiers, braces for control statements, this. for instance members and var as required by .editorconfig.
Preserve source-generated view/ViewModel wiring and existing MVVM ownership; use theme-aware WinUI resources.
